title: Kagamine Rin — Bloomy Idol♪〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... Not here either...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I was hoping that I'd be able to go back to that place if I found that fragment again.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (That place felt so strange and wondrous.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (All these cherry blossom petals danced in the air while the girls' thoughts and feelings sparkled as they hung from that tree's branches.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, we're gonna have a really big petal blizzard for our show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (But petals alone won't make it feel like a show under a big cherry blossom tree...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (It's not really possible to bring a whole tree over, but what if we made a prop that looks like one?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Hmm... No, I'm not sure we'd be able to make one in time for our show.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I guess I have no choice but to give up on my tree idea...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hm? Rin?
Why the long face?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh no. Your cute face shouldn't have a frown on it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
KAITO! MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I-I'm okay, really! I was just getting myself pumped up to practice for our spring show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. We see right through you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! I-I'm not lying!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But your eyes are moving all over the place. You still seem to refuse to make eye contact with us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, I was just...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You know you can tell us if there's something bothering you, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I'd probably just end up being a bother...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's the tickle monster...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Eep! Hahahaha!
MEIKO, stop! That tickles! Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What did I say about frowning with such a cute face? C'mon, give us a smile.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
M-MEIKO! Hahaha!
I... I can't breathe!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why don't you tell us what's on your mind as you laugh yourself silly?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha! Okay, I'll talk!
So please, stop tickling me...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. You're wondering if we can somehow put together a cherry blossom tree prop.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I agree that a tree would give our show a much more springlike feel.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But... I can't imagine how hard it would be to put one together right now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I really don't want to be a bother since I already asked you guys to help me look for cherry blossom trees...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
A bother?
I think you're jumping to the wrong conclusion...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin, why do you want to have a show under a cherry blossom tree so much?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why...? Because it'd be so much prettier that way, and our fans would be totally blown away by our show if we did...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In other words, you want to have a cherry blossom tree to make this show as good as it can be!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In my book, that doesn't make you a bother at all!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree. Also, you won't know if it's possible until you ask everyone about it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've come up with a wonderful idea, so we should definitely ask the others to hear what they think♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, it might be good to have some illustrations ready to go along with your explanation. Why don't you draw a simple set design for us?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! I'll give it a try...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So I think the stage would look really incredible if we made some cherry blossom branches like the ones in this sketch...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wh-What do you guys think...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It won't be easy even if we started right now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I do agree that the stage will look absolutely gorgeous♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd love to sing on a stage that's covered in cherry blossoms like the one you drew, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, let's give it a try.
Rin, we'll make such amazing props that even Minori and the girls will be left speechless♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku! Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: KAITO, MEIKO, I take it that we'll be able to make these in time since you both seem so optimistic about this endeavor?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. It'll be all hands on deck, but we should have enough time to pull this off.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, we won't know until we try.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, the theme for this show's “a new side of us”...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think that should include both our performance and the stage. Wouldn't it be great to show everyone how both have evolved?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that!
Let's start hammering out the details and figuring out our assignments.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
